# LokalBot

> Find what you said or saw on your Mac. LokalBot is a free, open-source (GPLv3) macOS app that records meetings without a bot, transcribes and summarizes them on-device, and searches your meetings and, if you turn it on, what you saw on screen. Processing runs locally by default, with no account, analytics, or hosted AI service.

Key facts:

- Platform: macOS 15.0 or later on Apple Silicon (M1 or later). No Intel, Windows, iOS, or web version.
- Price and license: free, GNU GPL v3. Source: https://github.com/stevyhacker/lokalbot
- Install: download LokalBot.dmg from https://github.com/stevyhacker/lokalbot/releases/latest or run `brew install --cask stevyhacker/tap/lokalbot`.
- Meetings: records the microphone and the meeting app's audio on separate tracks without joining the call. On a fresh install it asks through a notification before recording a detected meeting.
- Local models: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B is the default speech model (since 0.8.1); Parakeet, IBM Granite Speech, and Whisper large-v3 turbo are alternatives. Summaries use Qwen3.5 4B on a bundled llama.cpp runtime. Search uses EmbeddingGemma 2 embeddings.
- Optional backends: Apple Intelligence (macOS 26+), Ollama, and OpenAI-compatible servers. A non-local server must be explicitly approved before it receives meeting or workday context.
- Workday memory: day tracking starts with app names and window titles only. Saved screen text and encrypted screenshots are opt-in; screenshots are deleted after 14 days by default.
- Also includes: hold-to-talk dictation (⌥ Space), optional local autocomplete, Markdown/Obsidian/Logseq export, and a read-only CLI and MCP server that stay off until Agent Access is enabled.
- About you: an encrypted list of facts, preferences, goals, and principles about the user, from "Remember …" in Ask, items added in Settings, and what it learns overnight from the user's own words in meetings and typed requests. Ask uses it; agents can read only items the user shares, under a separate permission.
- Not supported: importing existing audio files; syncing between devices.

## Product

- [LokalBot home](https://www.lokalbot.com/): features, demo, and FAQ
- [About LokalBot](https://www.lokalbot.com/about): fact sheet, what it does and does not do
- [System requirements](https://www.lokalbot.com/system-requirements): macOS version, Apple Silicon, memory, disk, and permissions
- [Benchmarks](https://www.lokalbot.com/benchmarks): measured speech, speaker diarization, search, summary, autocomplete, and OCR results with methods and known gaps
- [Privacy policy](https://www.lokalbot.com/privacy): what stays on the Mac and exactly when the app uses the network

## Guides

- [Local AI meeting notes on your Mac](https://www.lokalbot.com/local-ai-meeting-notes-mac): bot-free capture, on-device transcription, private summaries, trade-offs, and setup
- [Offline meeting transcription on Mac](https://www.lokalbot.com/offline-meeting-transcription-mac): local speech models, two-track audio, timestamps, and no cloud upload
- [Record both sides of a Mac meeting without a bot](https://www.lokalbot.com/record-both-sides-mac-meeting-without-bot): microphone plus meeting-app audio as synchronized tracks
- [Local transcription models for Mac](https://www.lokalbot.com/local-transcription-models-mac): Granite Speech, Parakeet, Qwen3-ASR, and Whisper compared
- [Open-source AI meeting notes: what to verify](https://www.lokalbot.com/open-source-ai-meeting-notes): license, local processing, network boundaries, storage, builds, and updates
- [How do I let Claude Code or Codex search my meeting notes?](https://www.lokalbot.com/claude-code-codex-meeting-notes): read-only local MCP access to a meeting library, setup, tools, and where the data goes
- [My company blocks AI notetaker bots. What can I use?](https://www.lokalbot.com/ai-notetaker-bots-blocked-at-work): what a local recorder changes and an IT approval checklist
- [Can a bot-free meeting recorder tell who said what?](https://www.lokalbot.com/bot-free-meeting-recorder-speaker-labels): speaker separation without a bot, naming, and measured accuracy
- [How do I get meeting transcripts into Obsidian as Markdown?](https://www.lokalbot.com/meeting-transcripts-obsidian-markdown): one-off export, a daily Obsidian note, and a sync script using the CLI
